Market today: The mood is decidedly risk-off. Rising 10-year Treasury yields, warnings about Fed policy mistakes, and a strong correlation between oil and yields are creating a tough environment. This directly hurts your tech/chip names, especially on margin.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, decaying assets, and deeply underwater, amplifying your margin risk. QQQ (-0.77%) and SMH (-14.91%) are also showing weakness.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for any signs of reversal. Also, monitor Fed commentary for clarity on rate policy.

Bottom line: Focus on aggressive risk management and reducing exposure to highly volatile, leveraged positions.
plays: Seriously consider exiting SOXL and SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are decaying and deeply underwater, amplifying margin risk in this environment.
Trim QQQ and SMH to reduce overall tech/chip exposure. QQQ is near even, making it a good candidate to de-risk.
Watch SOXS (inverse semi ETF) for a potential hedge: entry 50.55-50.5, stop 50.07. This could offset some chip downside.
